filter_rule: Retain protein rows with at least 3 of 6 positive, finite observed intensities; exclude rows with 1-2 values as excessive_missing_values and rows with 0 values as no_valid_values.
imputation_method: Log2 scale: for a missing replicate with >=1 observed in its condition, impute mean(observed log2 intensities in same condition) - 0.15; if all 3 in that condition are absent, impute mean(observed log2 intensities in other condition) - 0.70. Observed values unchanged beyond log2; no random draws.
